comments.body: Ephemeral COPR build failed. @containers/packit-build please check.

What do I need to do to trigger the failure?

Using
```
sudo STORAGE_DRIVER=vfs bats -f "build with an id-mapped user namespace and file capabilities" tests/bud.bats
sudo STORAGE_DRIVER=overlay bats -f "build with an id-mapped user namespace and file capabilities" tests/bud.bats
```

both pass with buildah 1.45 on my system already? So I not sure this is testing the right thing?
